description: Synthetic cross-language news duplicate-detection evaluation set. All companies, people and events are invented (central banks are real institutions with invented decisions); dated Sept-Oct 2026. Each pair is the same event reported in English and in ja/zh/de by different outlets with different wording; each distractor is a different event on the same company/sector/topic that must not be clustered with its pair.

a.headline: Norvane Semiconductor third-quarter revenue rises 14% to $4.82 billion
a.summary: Norvane Semiconductor reported third-quarter revenue of $4.82 billion, up 14% from a year earlier, on strong data-center chip demand. Net income came in at $0.9 billion.

b.headline: ノーベイン・セミコンダクター、7~9月期は14%増収 データセンター向けがけん引
b.summary: ノーベイン・セミコンダクターが発表した7~9月期の売上高は48億2000万ドルで、前年同期比14%増だった。データセンター向け半導体の需要が伸び、純利益は9億ドルとなった。

a.headline: Kestrel Motors lifts full-year operating profit forecast to ¥1.9 trillion
a.summary: Japanese automaker Kestrel Motors raised its fiscal 2026 operating profit forecast to ¥1.9 trillion from ¥1.7 trillion on Oct 6, citing a weaker yen and strong hybrid sales.

b.headline: ケストレル自動車、今期の営業益予想を1兆9000億円に上方修正
b.summary: ケストレル自動車は6日、2026年度の連結営業利益予想を従来の1兆7000億円から1兆9000億円に引き上げた。円安の追い風に加え、ハイブリッド車の販売が好調。

a.headline: Halvorsen Pharma to buy Brightwell Biologics for $3.1 billion in cash
a.summary: Halvorsen Pharma agreed on Sept 22 to acquire Brightwell Biologics for $3.1 billion in an all-cash deal, adding a late-stage autoimmune drug portfolio.

b.headline: ハルボルセン製薬が米バイオ企業を買収へ 31億ドル、全額現金
b.summary: ハルボルセン製薬はブライトウェル・バイオロジクスを総額31億ドルの現金で買収すると22日発表した。自己免疫疾患薬の開発後期パイプラインを取り込む狙い。

a.headline: EU fines Veltra Cloud €410 million over data-handling breaches
a.summary: The European Commission fined Veltra Cloud €410 million on Oct 2 for violating data-protection rules in how it handled customer data across member states.

b.headline: 欧州委、ヴェルトラ・クラウドに制裁金4億1000万ユーロ 顧客データの扱いで違反
b.summary: 欧州委員会は2日、クラウド大手ヴェルトラが加盟国をまたぐ顧客データの取り扱いでデータ保護規則に違反したとして、4億1000万ユーロの制裁金を科した。

a.headline: Bank of Japan raises policy rate to 1.00% in a split vote
a.summary: The Bank of Japan lifted its short-term policy rate to 1.00% from 0.75% on Sept 18, with two board members dissenting, citing sticky services inflation.

b.headline: 日銀、政策金利を1.0%に引き上げ 18日の会合、2人が反対
b.summary: 日本銀行は18日の金融政策決定会合で、政策金利を0.75%から1.0%に引き上げることを決めた。サービス価格の粘り強い上昇を踏まえた判断で、政策委員2人が反対した。
b.outlet: マーケット・ジャーナル

a.headline: Tamura Appliances recalls 120,000 pressure cookers over faulty lid lock
a.summary: Tamura Appliances is recalling about 120,000 electric pressure cookers sold since 2024 after 31 reports of lids opening under pressure, including nine burn injuries.

b.headline: タムラ家電、圧力鍋12万台を自主回収 ふたのロック不具合で9人がやけど
b.summary: タムラ家電は2024年以降に販売した電気圧力鍋約12万台を自主回収する。加圧中にふたが開く事例が31件報告され、うち9人がやけどを負った。
b.outlet: 暮らしの安全ニュース

a.headline: Solvik Energy CEO Marta Lindqvist steps down; CFO named interim chief
a.summary: Solvik Energy said Chief Executive Marta Lindqvist resigned effective immediately on Sept 29. Finance chief Daniel Reyes will serve as interim CEO while the board searches for a successor.

b.headline: ソルビク・エナジーのリンドクヴィストCEOが辞任 後任選定まではレイエスCFOが代行
b.summary: ソルビク・エナジーは29日、マルタ・リンドクヴィスト最高経営責任者が即日辞任したと発表した。後任が決まるまでダニエル・レイエス最高財務責任者がCEO職を代行する。

a.headline: Aurelian Retail same-store sales climb 3.1% in second quarter
a.summary: Aurelian Retail posted second-quarter same-store sales growth of 3.1% and a profit of $212 million, helped by grocery and private-label gains.

b.headline: アウレリアン・リテール、既存店売上高3.1%増 食品とPB商品が好調
b.summary: アウレリアン・リテールの第2四半期の既存店売上高は前年同期比3.1%増だった。食品とプライベートブランド商品が伸び、利益は2億1200万ドル。

a.headline: Cobalt Freight agrees to acquire Meridian Logistics for $1.45 billion
a.summary: Cobalt Freight will buy Meridian Logistics for $1.45 billion including debt, creating the largest cold-chain trucking operator in North America, the companies said on Oct 1.

b.headline: コバルト・フレイト、メリディアン・ロジスティクスを14億5000万ドルで買収
b.summary: コバルト・フレイトは1日、メリディアン・ロジスティクスを負債込みで14億5000万ドルで買収すると発表した。統合により北米最大の低温物流トラック事業者になる。

a.headline: Pinewave Software cuts full-year revenue outlook as enterprise deals slip
a.summary: Pinewave Software lowered its fiscal 2026 revenue guidance to $2.10-$2.15 billion from $2.25-$2.30 billion after several large enterprise contracts were delayed. Shares fell 11%.

b.headline: パインウェーブ・ソフトが通期売上見通しを下方修正 大型案件の遅れで株価11%安
b.summary: パインウェーブ・ソフトウェアは2026年度の売上高見通しを22.5億~23億ドルから21億~21.5億ドルに引き下げた。大口の法人契約が先送りされた。株価は11%下落した。
b.outlet: テックマーケット通信

a.headline: FTC sues Brightline Marketplace over hard-to-cancel subscriptions
a.summary: The Federal Trade Commission sued Brightline Marketplace on Sept 25, alleging it enrolled millions of shoppers in paid memberships and made cancellation deliberately difficult.

b.headline: 米FTC、ブライトライン・マーケットプレイスを提訴 解約困難な有料会員制で
b.summary: 米連邦取引委員会(FTC)は25日、ブライトライン・マーケットプレイスが数百万人の利用者を有料会員に登録し、解約を意図的に難しくしていたとして提訴した。

a.headline: Fed cuts rates by a quarter point to 3.75%-4.00%
a.summary: The Federal Reserve lowered its benchmark rate by 25 basis points to a range of 3.75%-4.00% on Sept 16, pointing to a cooling labor market and signaling one more cut this year.

b.headline: FRB、0.25%利下げ 政策金利は3.75~4.00%に 年内あと1回の見通し
b.summary: 米連邦準備制度理事会(FRB)は16日、政策金利を0.25%引き下げ3.75~4.00%とした。労働市場の減速を理由に挙げ、年内にもう1回の利下げを示唆した。

a.headline: Orrin Auto recalls 86,000 SUVs for airbag inflator defect
a.summary: Orrin Auto is recalling 86,000 Trailmaster SUVs built between 2023 and 2025 because the driver airbag inflator may rupture. No injuries have been confirmed.

b.headline: オーリン・オート、SUV8万6000台をリコール エアバッグ部品に欠陥
b.summary: オーリン・オートは2023~25年に生産したSUV「トレイルマスター」8万6000台をリコールする。運転席エアバッグのガス発生装置が破裂する恐れがある。けが人は確認されていない。

a.headline: Lumio Bank names Hanna Kroll chair, succeeding Per Ostby
a.summary: Lumio Bank appointed Hanna Kroll, a former finance minister, as chair of its board starting Jan 1, replacing Per Ostby, who is retiring after nine years.

b.headline: ルミオ銀行、新会長にハンナ・クロル氏 元財務相、9年務めたオストビー氏の後任
b.summary: ルミオ銀行は、元財務相のハンナ・クロル氏を来年1月1日付で取締役会会長に起用すると発表した。9年間務めたペル・オストビー会長は退任する。

a.headline: Tidewater Airlines third-quarter profit jumps 22% to $312 million
a.summary: Tidewater Airlines reported third-quarter net profit of $312 million, up 22%, as lower fuel costs and strong transatlantic demand offset weaker domestic fares.

b.headline: タイドウォーター航空の7~9月期、純利益22%増の3億1200万ドル 燃料安と大西洋路線が寄与
b.summary: タイドウォーター航空の7~9月期の純利益は前年同期比22%増の3億1200万ドルだった。燃料費の低下と大西洋路線の好調が、国内線運賃の下落を補った。

a.headline: Nakagawa Steel and Verdant Metals agree to merge in ¥4.2 trillion combination
a.summary: Nakagawa Steel and Verdant Metals announced a merger on Oct 3 that would create a group with combined annual sales of ¥4.2 trillion. The deal is expected to close in April 2027.

b.headline: 中川製鉄とヴァーダント・メタルズが経営統合へ 売上高合計4兆2000億円
b.summary: 中川製鉄とヴァーダント・メタルズは3日、経営統合で合意したと発表した。統合後の売上高は合計4兆2000億円となる見込みで、2027年4月の完了を目指す。

a.headline: Bluepeak Gaming forecasts fiscal-year bookings of $1.2-$1.3 billion
a.summary: Bluepeak Gaming gave fiscal 2027 guidance for net bookings of $1.2-$1.3 billion, above analyst estimates, buoyed by the launch of its fantasy title Ashfall Realms in November.

b.headline: ブルーピーク・ゲーミング、来期の売上予約高12億~13億ドルを予想 市場予想上回る
b.summary: ブルーピーク・ゲーミングは2027年度のネット予約高を12億~13億ドルとする見通しを示し、アナリスト予想を上回った。11月発売のファンタジー新作「アッシュフォール・レルムズ」に期待が集まる。

a.headline: UK regulator fines Harrowgate Capital £38 million over reporting failures
a.summary: Britain's Financial Conduct Authority fined Harrowgate Capital £38 million on Sept 30 for failing to report millions of trades accurately between 2021 and 2024.

b.headline: 英金融当局、ハロウゲート・キャピタルに38百万ポンドの制裁金 取引報告の不備で
b.summary: 英金融行動監視機構(FCA)は30日、ハロウゲート・キャピタルが2021~24年の多数の取引を正確に報告しなかったとして、3800万ポンドの制裁金を科した。

a.headline: Quillon Biotech narrows third-quarter loss to $145 million
a.summary: Quillon Biotech reported a third-quarter net loss of $145 million, down from $198 million a year ago, as royalty income from its migraine drug rose 37%.

b.headline: 奎隆生物科技第三季度亏损收窄至1.45亿美元
b.summary: 奎隆生物科技公布第三季度净亏损1.45亿美元，上年同期为1.98亿美元。其偏头痛药物的特许权使用费收入增长37%，是亏损收窄的主因。

a.headline: Sunhaven Hotels raises 2026 RevPAR growth forecast to 6%-8%
a.summary: Sunhaven Hotels lifted its full-year revenue-per-available-room growth forecast to 6%-8% from 3%-5%, citing strong leisure travel in Asia and Europe.

b.headline: 森哈文酒店上调全年业绩指引 每间可售房收入增幅预期升至6%至8%
b.summary: 森哈文酒店集团将2026年每间可售房收入增幅预期由3%至5%上调至6%至8%，称亚洲和欧洲的休闲旅游需求强劲。

a.headline: Ardent Cement to acquire Polaris Building Materials for €2.2 billion
a.summary: Ardent Cement agreed to buy Polaris Building Materials in a €2.2 billion deal announced Sept 23, expanding its footprint in southern Europe. Closing is subject to antitrust approval.

b.headline: 雅登水泥拟22亿欧元收购北极星建材 扩大南欧布局
b.summary: 雅登水泥9月23日宣布，将以22亿欧元收购北极星建材，以拓展其在南欧的业务版图。交易仍需通过反垄断审查。

a.headline: US imposes new license requirement on exports of advanced AI accelerators
a.summary: The Commerce Department on Oct 5 introduced a license requirement for exports of advanced AI accelerators to 22 countries, effective Nov 15, in a tightening of controls.

b.headline: 美国商务部出台新规 对22国出口先进AI加速器须申请许可
b.summary: 美国商务部10月5日宣布，自11月15日起，向22个国家出口先进AI加速器需申请许可，出口管制进一步收紧。

a.headline: ECB holds deposit rate at 2.00% for a third straight meeting
a.summary: The European Central Bank left its deposit rate unchanged at 2.00% on Sept 10, saying inflation is near target but trade uncertainty clouds the growth outlook.

b.headline: 欧洲央行连续第三次会议维持存款利率2.00%不变
b.summary: 欧洲央行9月10日宣布，将存款机制利率维持在2.00%不变。官员表示通胀接近目标，但贸易不确定性给经济增长前景蒙上阴影。

a.headline: Kelvora Foods recalls 340 tonnes of frozen dumplings over listeria risk
a.summary: Kelvora Foods is recalling 340 tonnes of frozen pork dumplings sold in eight countries after routine testing found listeria at its Rotterdam plant.

b.headline: 凯尔沃拉食品召回340吨速冻饺子 鹿特丹工厂检出李斯特菌
b.summary: 凯尔沃拉食品因鹿特丹工厂例行检测发现李斯特菌，召回在八个国家销售的340吨速冻猪肉饺子。

a.headline: Fenwick Pharma CEO Ian Marsh to retire at year-end; Dr. Elena Voss to succeed him
a.summary: Fenwick Pharma said Ian Marsh will retire as chief executive on Dec 31 after 11 years. Research chief Dr. Elena Voss will take over on Jan 1.

b.headline: 芬威克制药CEO马什年底退休 研发主管埃琳娜·沃斯接任
b.summary: 芬威克制药宣布，执掌公司11年的首席执行官伊恩·马什将于12月31日退休，研发负责人埃琳娜·沃斯博士将自1月1日起接任。

a.headline: Ostrander Mining first-half profit slumps 31% on lower copper grades
a.summary: Ostrander Mining reported a 31% drop in first-half net profit to $540 million as ore grades at its Andes mine declined and costs rose 9%.

b.headline: 奥斯特兰德矿业上半年净利润下滑31%至5.4亿美元 铜矿品位下降
b.summary: 奥斯特兰德矿业公布上半年净利润同比下降31%，至5.4亿美元。安第斯矿区矿石品位走低，成本上升9%。

a.headline: Glimmer Telecom trims 2026 capital spending plan to $5.5 billion
a.summary: Glimmer Telecom cut its 2026 capital expenditure plan to $5.5 billion from $6.2 billion, slowing its 5G standalone rollout as it prioritizes debt reduction.

b.headline: 格里默电信下调2026年资本开支至55亿美元 放缓5G独立组网建设
b.summary: 格里默电信将2026年资本开支计划从62亿美元削减至55亿美元，放缓5G独立组网部署，优先降低负债。

a.headline: Rivenhall Insurance sells life unit to Castellan Re for $780 million
a.summary: Rivenhall Insurance agreed on Oct 7 to sell its closed-book life insurance unit to Castellan Re for $780 million, freeing up capital for buybacks.

b.headline: 里文霍尔保险以7.8亿美元出售寿险业务给卡斯特兰再保险
b.summary: 里文霍尔保险10月7日宣布，将其封闭式寿险业务以7.8亿美元出售给卡斯特兰再保险，释放的资本将用于股票回购。

a.headline: UK competition watchdog opens in-depth probe into Hexa Grocery-Pantry Co deal
a.summary: Britain's CMA on Sept 26 referred Hexa Grocery's proposed £1.6 billion takeover of Pantry Co to a Phase 2 investigation over concerns about local store overlaps.

b.headline: 英国竞争监管机构对赫克萨超市收购潘特里展开深入调查
b.summary: 英国竞争与市场管理局9月26日表示，因担心门店区域重叠，将赫克萨超市16亿英镑收购潘特里的交易移交第二阶段审查。

a.headline: Bank of England holds Bank Rate at 3.75% as MPC splits 7-2
a.summary: The Bank of England kept Bank Rate at 3.75% on Sept 17, with seven of nine MPC members voting to hold and two preferring a cut.

b.headline: 英国央行维持基准利率3.75%不变 货币政策委员会以7比2表决
b.summary: 英国央行9月17日将基准利率维持在3.75%，货币政策委员会九名成员中七人投票支持按兵不动，两人主张降息。

a.headline: Nordhaven Bikes recalls 52,000 e-bike batteries over fire risk
a.summary: Nordhaven Bikes is recalling 52,000 e-bike battery packs after 17 reports of overheating, including four house fires. Owners are told to stop charging them.

b.headline: 诺德港自行车召回5.2万块电动自行车电池 存在起火隐患
b.summary: 诺德港自行车因收到17起电池过热报告（其中4起引发住宅火灾），召回5.2万块电动自行车电池组，并提醒用户停止充电。

a.headline: Calder Aerospace names Rosa Menendez chief executive
a.summary: Calder Aerospace appointed Rosa Menendez, previously head of its engines division, as CEO on Oct 8, succeeding Tom Hargrave, who left amid delivery delays.

b.headline: 卡尔德航空航天任命罗莎·梅嫩德斯为首席执行官
b.summary: 卡尔德航空航天10月8日宣布，由原发动机业务负责人罗莎·梅嫩德斯出任首席执行官，接替因交付延误离职的汤姆·哈格雷夫。

a.headline: Mirabel Cosmetics third-quarter sales rise 6% to €1.96 billion
a.summary: Mirabel Cosmetics reported third-quarter sales of €1.96 billion, up 6% on an organic basis, with skincare sales in Asia growing 11%.

b.headline: 米拉贝尔化妆品第三季度销售额增长6%至19.6亿欧元
b.summary: 米拉贝尔化妆品第三季度销售额为19.6亿欧元，内生增长6%，其中亚洲护肤品类销售增长11%。

a.headline: Harlan Steel guides fourth-quarter shipments down 8% on weak construction demand
a.summary: Harlan Steel forecast fourth-quarter shipments of 3.4 million tonnes, 8% below last year, and said it will idle one blast furnace for maintenance.

b.headline: 哈兰钢铁预计第四季度出货量下降8% 建筑需求疲软
b.summary: 哈兰钢铁预计第四季度出货量为340万吨，同比减少8%，并表示将停产一座高炉进行检修。

a.headline: Zephyr Payments buys Lodestar Fintech for $950 million
a.summary: Zephyr Payments agreed to acquire Lodestar Fintech for $950 million in cash and stock on Oct 4, adding its small-business lending platform.

b.headline: 泽菲尔支付拟9.5亿美元收购洛德斯塔金融科技
b.summary: 泽菲尔支付10月4日宣布，将以现金加股票方式、总价9.5亿美元收购洛德斯塔金融科技，获得其小微企业贷款平台。

a.headline: Swiss National Bank keeps policy rate at 0% and warns on franc strength
a.summary: The Swiss National Bank held its policy rate at 0% on Sept 25 and said it stands ready to intervene in currency markets if the franc strengthens further.

b.headline: 瑞士央行维持政策利率0%不变 称必要时干预汇市应对瑞郎走强
b.summary: 瑞士央行9月25日将政策利率维持在0%，并表示若瑞郎进一步升值，随时准备干预外汇市场。

a.headline: Kessler Chemicals third-quarter operating profit falls 8% to €612 million
a.summary: Kessler Chemicals said third-quarter operating profit fell 8% to €612 million as European energy costs and weak demand from carmakers weighed on margins.

b.headline: Kessler Chemicals: Operatives Ergebnis im dritten Quartal um 8 Prozent gesunken
b.summary: Der Chemiekonzern Kessler Chemicals hat im dritten Quartal ein operatives Ergebnis von 612 Millionen Euro erzielt, 8 Prozent weniger als im Vorjahr. Hohe Energiepreise und schwache Nachfrage der Autoindustrie belasteten die Margen.

a.headline: Tarvos Logistics cuts 2026 operating profit forecast to €1.1-1.2 billion
a.summary: Tarvos Logistics reduced its 2026 operating profit outlook to €1.1-1.2 billion from €1.3-1.4 billion on weaker air freight volumes and higher labor costs.

b.headline: Tarvos Logistics senkt Gewinnprognose für 2026 auf bis zu 1,2 Milliarden Euro
b.summary: Tarvos Logistics erwartet für 2026 nur noch ein operatives Ergebnis von 1,1 bis 1,2 Milliarden Euro, zuvor waren 1,3 bis 1,4 Milliarden angepeilt. Grund sind schwächere Luftfrachtmengen und höhere Personalkosten.

a.headline: Elmstone Telecom to acquire Fibrio Networks for $2.6 billion
a.summary: Elmstone Telecom agreed to buy fiber operator Fibrio Networks for $2.6 billion including debt, announced Sept 30, to extend its broadband coverage to 4 million more homes.

b.headline: Elmstone Telecom übernimmt Glasfaseranbieter Fibrio für 2,6 Milliarden Dollar
b.summary: Elmstone Telecom kauft den Glasfaserbetreiber Fibrio Networks inklusive Schulden für 2,6 Milliarden Dollar, wie das Unternehmen am 30. September mitteilte. Das Netz soll vier Millionen zusätzliche Haushalte erreichen.

a.headline: German cartel office fines three cement makers €330 million for price fixing
a.summary: Germany's Bundeskartellamt fined three cement producers a combined €330 million on Oct 1 for coordinating prices and regional quotas for more than a decade.

b.headline: Kartellamt verhängt 330 Millionen Euro Bußgeld gegen drei Zementhersteller
b.summary: Das Bundeskartellamt hat drei Zementhersteller wegen Preisabsprachen und Gebietsquoten über mehr als zehn Jahre mit insgesamt 330 Millionen Euro belegt, teilte die Behörde am 1. Oktober mit.

a.headline: Sweden's Riksbank cuts policy rate to 1.50%
a.summary: Sveriges Riksbank lowered its policy rate by 25 basis points to 1.50% on Sept 24, saying a stronger krona and subdued demand will keep inflation below target.

b.headline: Schwedische Notenbank senkt Leitzins auf 1,50 Prozent
b.summary: Die Riksbank hat den Leitzins am 24. September um 0,25 Prozentpunkte auf 1,50 Prozent gesenkt. Eine stärkere Krone und schwache Nachfrage dürften die Inflation unter dem Zielwert halten.

a.headline: Aldrin Toys recalls 210,000 building sets over loose magnets
a.summary: Aldrin Toys is recalling 210,000 magnetic building sets sold in Europe and the US after magnets detached and were swallowed by children in 14 cases.

b.headline: Spielwarenhersteller Aldrin ruft 210.000 Magnetbaukästen zurück
b.summary: Aldrin Toys holt in Europa und den USA 210.000 Magnetbaukästen zurück, weil sich Magnete lösen können. In 14 Fällen wurden sie von Kindern verschluckt.

a.headline: Wexford Retail CFO resigns after accounting review
a.summary: Wexford Retail's finance chief, Nathan Ellery, resigned on Oct 2 after an internal review found errors in the treatment of supplier rebates. The company delayed its annual report.

b.headline: Wexford Retail: Finanzchef Ellery tritt nach Bilanzprüfung zurück
b.summary: Finanzvorstand Nathan Ellery von Wexford Retail ist am 2. Oktober zurückgetreten, nachdem eine interne Prüfung Fehler bei der Verbuchung von Lieferantenboni aufgedeckt hatte. Der Geschäftsbericht verzögert sich.

a.headline: Bellamy Hotels third-quarter net profit rises to $88 million
a.summary: Bellamy Hotels posted third-quarter net profit of $88 million versus $61 million a year earlier, as occupancy rose to 78% and room rates climbed 5%.

b.headline: Bellamy Hotels steigert Quartalsgewinn auf 88 Millionen Dollar
b.summary: Die Hotelgruppe Bellamy Hotels verdiente im dritten Quartal 88 Millionen Dollar nach 61 Millionen im Vorjahr. Die Auslastung stieg auf 78 Prozent, die Zimmerpreise legten um 5 Prozent zu.

a.headline: Ironvale Steel raises full-year earnings guidance after stronger pricing
a.summary: Ironvale Steel raised its 2026 core earnings forecast to €2.3-2.5 billion from €2.0-2.2 billion on Oct 6, citing higher steel prices in Europe after new import quotas.

b.headline: Ironvale Steel hebt Jahresprognose an: Kernergebnis soll auf bis zu 2,5 Milliarden Euro steigen
b.summary: Ironvale Steel erwartet für 2026 nun ein bereinigtes Kernergebnis von 2,3 bis 2,5 Milliarden Euro statt 2,0 bis 2,2 Milliarden. Höhere Stahlpreise nach den neuen EU-Importquoten geben Rückenwind.

a.headline: Quartz Capital to take Maple Software private in $5.4 billion buyout
a.summary: Private equity firm Quartz Capital agreed to acquire Maple Software for $5.4 billion, or $38 a share, a 29% premium. The board unanimously backed the offer on Sept 28.

b.headline: Finanzinvestor Quartz Capital will Maple Software für 5,4 Milliarden Dollar übernehmen
b.summary: Quartz Capital bietet 38 Dollar je Aktie für Maple Software, ein Aufschlag von 29 Prozent und insgesamt 5,4 Milliarden Dollar. Der Verwaltungsrat stimmte dem Angebot am 28. September einstimmig zu.

a.headline: EU clears Verano-Altus merger on condition of three plant sales
a.summary: The European Commission approved the merger of packaging groups Verano and Altus on Oct 8, provided the combined firm sells three plants in Germany, Poland and Spain.

b.headline: EU-Kommission genehmigt Fusion von Verano und Altus unter Auflagen
b.summary: Die EU-Kommission hat den Zusammenschluss der Verpackungskonzerne Verano und Altus am 8. Oktober genehmigt. Bedingung ist der Verkauf von drei Werken in Deutschland, Polen und Spanien.

a.headline: Bank of Canada cuts key rate to 2.25%
a.summary: The Bank of Canada lowered its overnight rate by a quarter point to 2.25% on Sept 9, citing a softening job market and the drag from U.S. tariffs.

b.headline: Kanadas Notenbank senkt Leitzins auf 2,25 Prozent
b.summary: Die Bank of Canada hat ihren Leitzins am 9. September um 0,25 Punkte auf 2,25 Prozent gesenkt. Sie verwies auf den schwächeren Arbeitsmarkt und die Belastung durch US-Zölle.

a.headline: Halden Motors recalls 31,000 electric cars over brake software fault
a.summary: Halden Motors is recalling 31,000 Nordlys electric cars to update software after a fault could reduce regenerative braking. The fix will be applied over the air.

b.headline: Halden Motors ruft 31.000 Elektroautos wegen Bremssoftware zurück
b.summary: Halden Motors holt 31.000 Elektroautos vom Typ Nordlys zurück, weil ein Softwarefehler die Rekuperationsbremse schwächen kann. Das Update soll per Funk aufgespielt werden.

a.headline: Strand Pharma names Dr. Katrin Mohr chairwoman after activist pressure
a.summary: Strand Pharma named Dr. Katrin Mohr as chairwoman on Oct 5, replacing Gerald Fitch, following months of pressure from an activist investor holding 4.6% of shares.

b.headline: Strand Pharma: Katrin Mohr löst Gerald Fitch an der Aufsichtsratsspitze ab
b.summary: Nach monatelangem Druck eines aktivistischen Investors mit 4,6 Prozent der Anteile hat Strand Pharma am 5. Oktober Katrin Mohr zur Vorsitzenden berufen. Sie folgt auf Gerald Fitch.

a.headline: Cavendish Brewing first-half profit up 12% on premium beer sales
a.summary: Cavendish Brewing reported first-half net profit of £274 million, up 12%, as premium lager volumes grew 4% and it raised prices in the UK.

b.headline: Cavendish Brewing: Halbjahresgewinn steigt um 12 Prozent auf 274 Millionen Pfund
b.summary: Die Brauerei Cavendish Brewing hat im ersten Halbjahr 274 Millionen Pfund verdient, ein Plus von 12 Prozent. Der Absatz von Premium-Lagerbier wuchs um 4 Prozent, in Großbritannien wurden die Preise erhöht.

a.headline: Ravelle Semiconductors forecasts fourth-quarter revenue of $1.35-$1.45 billion
a.summary: Ravelle Semiconductors guided fourth-quarter revenue to $1.35-$1.45 billion, above the $1.30 billion consensus, on rising demand for automotive power chips.

b.headline: Ravelle Semiconductors erwartet im Schlussquartal bis zu 1,45 Milliarden Dollar Umsatz
b.summary: Ravelle Semiconductors rechnet für das vierte Quartal mit 1,35 bis 1,45 Milliarden Dollar Umsatz und liegt damit über der Analystenschätzung von 1,30 Milliarden. Treiber ist die Nachfrage nach Leistungshalbleitern für Autos.

a.headline: Tessell Dairy rejects £1.9 billion takeover bid from Brightmoor Foods
a.summary: Tessell Dairy's board rejected Brightmoor Foods' £1.9 billion offer of 640 pence a share on Oct 3, calling it opportunistic and undervaluing the business.

b.headline: Tessell Dairy lehnt Übernahmeangebot von Brightmoor über 1,9 Milliarden Pfund ab
b.summary: Der Verwaltungsrat von Tessell Dairy hat das Angebot von Brightmoor Foods über 640 Pence je Aktie, insgesamt 1,9 Milliarden Pfund, am 3. Oktober abgelehnt. Es sei opportunistisch und unterbewerte das Unternehmen.

a.headline: SEC fines Oakridge Asset Management $44 million over undisclosed fees
a.summary: The U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission fined Oakridge Asset Management $44 million on Sept 29 for failing to disclose fees charged to retirement-fund clients.

b.headline: US-Börsenaufsicht verhängt 44 Millionen Dollar Strafe gegen Oakridge Asset Management
b.summary: Die SEC hat den Vermögensverwalter Oakridge Asset Management am 29. September zu 44 Millionen Dollar Strafe verurteilt, weil er Gebühren gegenüber Kunden aus der Altersvorsorge nicht offengelegt hatte.

distractors.headline: Norvane Semiconductor second-quarter revenue rises 9% to $4.23 billion
distractors.summary: Norvane Semiconductor posted second-quarter revenue of $4.23 billion, up 9%, with net income of $0.71 billion as smartphone chip sales stalled.

distractors.headline: ケストレル自動車、25年度の営業益予想を1兆6000億円に上方修正
distractors.summary: ケストレル自動車は2025年度の連結営業利益予想を従来の1兆4000億円から1兆6000億円に引き上げた。北米での値上げ効果が出ている。

distractors.headline: Halvorsen Pharma kauft Lumera Therapeutics für 640 Millionen Dollar
distractors.summary: Halvorsen Pharma übernimmt das Biotech-Unternehmen Lumera Therapeutics für 640 Millionen Dollar, um seine Augenheilkunde-Sparte zu stärken.

distractors.headline: EU fines Orbis Cloud €140 million over software bundling
distractors.summary: The European Commission fined Orbis Cloud, a Veltra rival, €140 million for tying its productivity software to its cloud services.

distractors.headline: 日本央行7月会议维持政策利率0.75%不变
distractors.summary: 日本央行在7月会议上将政策利率维持在0.75%，称需要更多时间评估工资增长的持续性，两名委员主张加息。

distractors.headline: Tamura Appliances recalls 18,000 rice cookers over power cord overheating
distractors.summary: Tamura Appliances is recalling 18,000 rice cookers because the power cord can overheat. Two minor burn injuries were reported.

distractors.headline: ソルビク・エナジー、新CFOにプリヤ・アナンド氏を起用
distractors.summary: ソルビク・エナジーは、後任の最高財務責任者としてプリヤ・アナンド氏を起用すると発表した。前任者は財務部門の再編を機に退任する。

distractors.headline: Aurelian Retail first-quarter same-store sales rise 1.8%
distractors.summary: Aurelian Retail reported first-quarter same-store sales growth of 1.8% and a profit of $167 million, held back by weak apparel demand.

distractors.headline: Cobalt Freight übernimmt Dockline für 210 Millionen Dollar
distractors.summary: Cobalt Freight kauft den Hafenlogistiker Dockline für 210 Millionen Dollar und baut damit sein Geschäft an der US-Ostküste aus.

distractors.headline: 派恩韦夫软件下调2025财年营收预期至19.5亿至20亿美元
distractors.summary: 派恩韦夫软件将2025财年营收指引下调至19.5亿至20亿美元，原因是中小企业客户流失增加，股价下跌6%。

distractors.headline: FTC sues Gatherly Marketplace over fake product reviews
distractors.summary: The Federal Trade Commission sued Gatherly Marketplace on Sept 11, alleging it allowed paid fake reviews to inflate seller ratings.

distractors.headline: FRB、7月会合で政策金利を4.00~4.25%に据え置き
distractors.summary: 米連邦準備制度理事会は7月の会合で政策金利を4.00~4.25%に据え置いた。関税の物価への影響を見極める必要があるとした。

distractors.headline: Orrin Auto recalls 12,400 pickup trucks over brake hose leak
distractors.summary: Orrin Auto is recalling 12,400 Ridgeline pickups from the 2024 model year because a brake hose can leak, lengthening stopping distances.

distractors.headline: Lumio Bank ernennt Jonas Berg zum neuen Vorstandschef
distractors.summary: Lumio Bank hat Jonas Berg zum Vorstandsvorsitzenden ernannt. Er löst Ingrid Falk ab, die nach sechs Jahren an der Spitze zurücktritt.

distractors.headline: Tidewater Airlines second-quarter profit slips 5% to $418 million
distractors.summary: Tidewater Airlines said second-quarter net profit fell 5% to $418 million as a pilot strike cancelled 1,200 flights in June.

distractors.headline: 中川製鉄、電炉事業を売却へ 売却額は1200億円
distractors.summary: 中川製鉄は電炉事業の子会社を投資ファンドに1200億円で売却すると発表した。主力の高炉事業に経営資源を集中する。

distractors.headline: 蓝峰游戏上调第二季度预期 预订额升至2.9亿美元
distractors.summary: 蓝峰游戏将第二季度净预订额预期上调至2.9亿美元，原因是老游戏《霜线战记》的内购收入超出预期。

distractors.headline: UK regulator fines Harrowgate Capital £6 million over 2022 reporting lapse
distractors.summary: The FCA fined Harrowgate Capital £6 million in 2025 for a separate lapse in anti-money-laundering controls identified in 2022.

distractors.headline: Quillon Biotech meldet positive Phase-3-Daten für Migränemittel
distractors.summary: Quillon Biotech hat positive Phase-3-Ergebnisse für sein neues Migränemittel vorgelegt. Die Zahl der Migränetage sank in der Studie um 52 Prozent.

distractors.headline: Sunhaven Hotels cuts 2025 RevPAR forecast to 1%-2% on weak U.S. demand
distractors.summary: Sunhaven Hotels lowered its 2025 revenue-per-available-room growth forecast to 1%-2% from 3%-4% as U.S. business travel softened.

distractors.headline: アーデント・セメント、ポーランド工場を3億ユーロで売却
distractors.summary: アーデント・セメントはポーランドのセメント工場を3億ユーロで売却すると発表した。債務圧縮が目的。

distractors.headline: Commerce Department adds nine Chinese firms to export blacklist
distractors.summary: The Commerce Department added nine Chinese technology firms to its entity list on Sept 12, barring them from receiving U.S. goods without a license.

distractors.headline: 欧洲央行7月会议将存款利率维持在2.00% 暗示可能再次降息
distractors.summary: 欧洲央行7月会议将存款利率维持在2.00%，行长称若通胀低于预期，不排除年内再次降息。

distractors.headline: Kelvora Foods recalls 40 tonnes of canned soup over metal fragments
distractors.summary: Kelvora Foods recalled 40 tonnes of canned vegetable soup in the UK after fragments of metal were found in several cans.

distractors.headline: Fenwick Pharma beruft Dr. Hugo Brandt zum neuen Forschungschef
distractors.summary: Fenwick Pharma hat Dr. Hugo Brandt zum Leiter der Forschung ernannt. Er folgt auf Elena Voss, die in den Vorstand aufrückt.

distractors.headline: Ostrander Mining first-half profit rises 18% to $783 million in 2025
distractors.summary: Ostrander Mining's first-half 2025 net profit rose 18% to $783 million on higher copper prices and record output at its Andes mine.

distractors.headline: 格里默电信拟发行20亿美元债券 为5G频谱付款融资
distractors.summary: 格里默电信计划发行20亿美元高级债券，所得款项将用于支付新获得的5G频谱费用。

distractors.headline: リーベンホール保険、再保険子会社を5億ドルで売却
distractors.summary: リーベンホール保険は損害再保険を手がける子会社を、別の再保険会社に5億ドルで売却すると発表した。

distractors.headline: CMA clears Hexa Grocery's £420 million purchase of Fresh Corner stores
distractors.summary: The CMA cleared Hexa Grocery's £420 million acquisition of 85 Fresh Corner convenience stores without conditions on Sept 3.

distractors.headline: Bank of England senkt Leitzins im August auf 3,75 Prozent
distractors.summary: Die Bank of England hat den Leitzins im August um 0,25 Punkte auf 3,75 Prozent gesenkt. Fünf Mitglieder stimmten für die Senkung, vier dagegen.

distractors.headline: Nordhaven Bikes recalls 9,000 folding bikes over frame cracks
distractors.summary: Nordhaven Bikes recalled 9,000 folding bikes whose frames can crack at the hinge. Eleven riders reported falls.

distractors.headline: カルダー・エアロスペース、航空機の引き渡し延期を発表
distractors.summary: カルダー・エアロスペースは部品不足のため、年内に予定していた航空機の引き渡し計画を約15%減らすと発表した。

distractors.headline: Mirabel Cosmetics second-quarter sales rise 3% to €1.84 billion
distractors.summary: Mirabel Cosmetics reported second-quarter sales of €1.84 billion, up 3% organically, with Chinese demand for fragrance falling 4%.

distractors.headline: 哈兰钢铁第三季度出货量增长4% 达370万吨
distractors.summary: 哈兰钢铁公布第三季度出货量为370万吨，同比增长4%，受益于基建项目订单增加。

distractors.headline: Zephyr Payments verkauft Kartengeschäft für 400 Millionen Dollar
distractors.summary: Zephyr Payments trennt sich von seinem Kreditkartengeschäft in Lateinamerika und erhält dafür 400 Millionen Dollar.

distractors.headline: Swiss National Bank cuts policy rate to 0% in June
distractors.summary: The Swiss National Bank cut its policy rate by a quarter point to 0% on June 19, as a strong franc pushed inflation below zero.

distractors.headline: Kessler Chemicals second-quarter operating profit rises 3% to €668 million
distractors.summary: Kessler Chemicals reported second-quarter operating profit of €668 million, up 3%, helped by cost cuts at its German plants.

distractors.headline: Tarvos Logistics bestätigt Prognose für 2025 von 1,3 bis 1,4 Milliarden Euro
distractors.summary: Tarvos Logistics hat seine Jahresprognose 2025 bestätigt und rechnet weiter mit einem operativen Ergebnis von 1,3 bis 1,4 Milliarden Euro.

distractors.headline: エルムストーン・テレコム、携帯基地局事業を17億ドルで売却
distractors.summary: エルムストーン・テレコムは携帯電話基地局事業を17億ドルで売却すると発表した。調達資金で光ファイバー網への投資を拡大する。

distractors.headline: French competition authority fines two cement makers €95 million
distractors.summary: France's competition authority fined two cement producers €95 million in total for sharing sensitive pricing data in the Paris region.

distractors.headline: 瑞典央行6月会议维持政策利率1.75%不变
distractors.summary: 瑞典央行6月会议将政策利率维持在1.75%，称通胀回升速度快于预期，需要观望。

distractors.headline: Aldrin Toys recalls 35,000 plush toys over choking hazard
distractors.summary: Aldrin Toys is recalling 35,000 plush animals because the eyes can detach, posing a choking hazard to infants.

distractors.headline: Wexford Retail ernennt Lena Hartmann zur neuen Finanzchefin
distractors.summary: Wexford Retail hat Lena Hartmann zur neuen Finanzvorständin berufen. Sie kommt von einem Konkurrenten und tritt im Januar an.

distractors.headline: Bellamy Hotels second-quarter net profit falls to $54 million
distractors.summary: Bellamy Hotels reported second-quarter net profit of $54 million, down from $70 million, as renovation closures cut occupancy to 71%.

distractors.headline: アイアンヴェール・スチール、通期利益見通しを引き下げ 欧州の需要低迷で
distractors.summary: アイアンヴェール・スチールは2025年のコア利益見通しを20億~22億ユーロから18億~19億ユーロに引き下げた。

distractors.headline: Quartz Capital buys Delta Logistics Software for $1.2 billion
distractors.summary: Quartz Capital agreed to acquire Delta Logistics Software for $1.2 billion in a deal announced on Sept 15.

distractors.headline: 欧盟委员会对瓦拉诺与奥尔塔斯合并展开深入调查
distractors.summary: 欧盟委员会7月启动对包装集团瓦拉诺与奥尔塔斯合并案的深入调查，担心德国和波兰市场竞争减弱。

distractors.headline: Bank of Canada holds rate at 2.50% in July
distractors.summary: The Bank of Canada held its overnight rate at 2.50% on July 29, saying it needs more clarity on trade policy before cutting.

distractors.headline: Halden Motors ruft 8.000 Hybridfahrzeuge wegen Kraftstoffleitung zurück
distractors.summary: Halden Motors ruft 8.000 Hybridfahrzeuge zurück, weil eine Kraftstoffleitung undicht werden kann. Es besteht Brandgefahr.

distractors.headline: Strand Pharma appoints new chief financial officer
distractors.summary: Strand Pharma named Oliver Grant as chief financial officer, replacing Susan Pike, who will retire at the end of the year.

distractors.headline: キャベンディッシュ・ブルーイング、25年上期は6%減益
distractors.summary: キャベンディッシュ・ブルーイングの2025年上期の純利益は245百万ポンドで6%減った。猛暑でビール販売量が落ち込んだ。

distractors.headline: Ravelle Semiconductors forecasts third-quarter revenue of $1.20-$1.30 billion
distractors.summary: Ravelle Semiconductors guided third-quarter revenue to $1.20-$1.30 billion, in line with expectations, as industrial demand stayed soft.

distractors.headline: 布莱特穆尔食品完成对另一家乳企的收购 作价8.5亿英镑
distractors.summary: 布莱特穆尔食品完成对乳制品企业奥克利乳业的收购，作价8.5亿英镑，交易获监管部门无条件批准。

distractors.headline: SEC fines Oakridge Asset Management $12 million over 2023 marketing violations
distractors.summary: The SEC fined Oakridge Asset Management $12 million in 2024 for misleading performance advertising to retail investors.
